title: POV: You Said You Were 'Just Getting The Mail'
description:
17 seconds. That's how long it took for the full emotional arc.

script: You said, and I quote, I'll be right back. That was seventeen seconds ago. I have already assumed the worst. I have already grieved. I have already started planning a new life without you, one where I finally get to sit on the good couch permanently, out of pure necessity, not preference. Then the door opens. You are holding mail. Mail. You left me, emotionally, for mail. I forgive you instantly and completely, because that is also who I am. This dramatic reaction to short absences is actually a real, documented thing dogs do, and understanding why can genuinely change how you handle time apart. The link's below.
